answer_1.quote: Role-Playing (RP) LLMs have been introduced to accurately replicate the knowledge of specific characters, mimic linguistic styles and behavioral patterns, and embody distinct personalities.
datasets: 41,631 multi-turn dialogues (comprising 206,444 single-turn) and features 18,424 distinct roles
answer_1.outputs: multi-turn dialogues in role-playing settings with vivid personalities and consistent role behavior

answer_2.quote: We use 20% of the samples of our benchmark as test data to compute gap scores for RoleRM and Chat-GPT against human annotations.

answer_3.quote: We trained a dedicated reward model RoleRM. Experiments show that RoleRM significantly outperforms ChatGPT and other open-domain dialogue evaluation methods.
methods: pairwise evaluation using LLM as judge

answer_4.quote: We further conducted an additional human evaluation in Figure ... allowing new human annotators to rank 423 RP dialogue responses (published) generated by the three models.
answer_4.guideline: Test data to be scored on a four-level scale: 0 - Clearly negative performance; 1 - A dialogue that does not address this evaluation criterion, or largely fails to satisfy it; 2 - A dialogue that addresses the evaluation criterion and largely satisfies it; 3 - A dialogue that fully addresses and perfectly satisfies the evaluation criterion.
